title: Amounts with VAT come out one cent short
description: A 10.05 € line at 10 % gives 11.05 € and it should be 11.06 €.

title: Due date on a Sunday is not moved to Monday
description: An invoice issued on 6/3/2026 at 30 days is due on Sunday 5/4. It should be Monday 6/4.

title: Commercial discounts on invoices
description: Allow a % discount on the subtotal before VAT.
